purpose: Wave-4 regional skilling hub fill for Asgarnia and Misthalin permanent infrastructure still thin or only footnoted after asgarnia/misthalin packs, guilds-hubs, invention-arch, and ironman-gaps. Targets Port Sarim / Rimmington / Entrana Law / Camdozaal Sacred Forge / Mining Guild metal-bank loop (Asgarnia) and Senntisten dig / Empty Throne Room / Croesus Front skilling / Varrock Museum kudos / Velucia collections / Misthalin RC altars / Varrock lumber yard / Fort free sawmill / Construction Contracts / Mysterious monolith / Thieves' Guild hub / Lumbridge-Edgeville-Draynor hubs / Giant Oyster (Misthalin). Complements existing asgarnia:mining-guild, asgarnia:runecrafting-altars, misthalin:archaeology-campus-hub, misthalin:thieves-guild-master-tools, misthalin:fort-forinthry-workshop, misthalin:plank-box without re-emitting those exact ids.

policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary Equilibrium geography. region_hints lists support pressure. required_regions only when every listed region is a hard gate. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global in region fields. Senntisten / Croesus / Empty Throne Room use historical Misthalin working taxonomy (Catalyst + wiki League badges). Fort Forinthry remains Misthalin working taxonomy.
policy.duplicate_guard: Do not re-emit: asgarnia:mining-guild, asgarnia:mining-guild-resource-dungeon, asgarnia:runecrafting-altars (Mind/Body/Law package), asgarnia:taverley-burthorpe-skilling-hub, misthalin:archaeology-campus-hub, misthalin:archaeology-collectors, misthalin:thieves-guild-master-tools, misthalin:fort-forinthry-workshop, misthalin:plank-box, misthalin:sanas-fyrtorch, misthalin:taggas-corehammer, misthalin:seed-bag. This file adds first-class hub/facility rows those ids only footnoted.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise permanent hubs, free/plank infrastructure, altar geography, dig-site access, museum progression, and ironman-essential skilling loops. Do not invent XP/hour or mirror every shop SKU.
policy.rate_rule: Unlock state, requirements, and effects only. Training rates belong in training datasets.
policy.rs3_terminology: RS3 Camdozaal Sacred Forge is the Imcando forge under Ice Mountain (Defender of Varrock + pickaxe/hatchet of life and death craft) — not OSRS barronite shard exchange. Construction Contracts award contract credits for plank box + master constructor outfit. Giant Oyster is a monthly D&D via Beneath Cursed Tides / Wizards' Tower Myrtle.
